title: 五話　失敗作 開発チームが間借りしている格納庫にて、俺はスミス博士とアリソン博士の二人に学園での出来事を説明していた。
content: ## Chapter 5: The Failure

In the hangar where the development team was temporarily housed, I was explaining the events at the academy to Dr. Smith and Dr. Allison. I had already informed them of the situation via message, but I was answering their request for details.
"──That concludes my report."

Dr. Smith, having finished listening to my explanation, put a hand to his forehead, looking troubled but not alarmed. "I never expected the academy girls to find out. Allison-kun said they'd be disgusted if we told them honestly, so we went to all that trouble to keep it top secret."
For Dr. Smith, it seemed to be merely a matter of making the experiment more difficult.

In contrast, Dr. Allison had a serious expression. "If the information leaked, the most suspicious person is the Principal. She demanded our information disclosure as a condition for providing the academy's facilities, after all."
Dr. Smith didn't seem very interested, nor did he intend to find out who leaked the information. "We signed a non-disclosure agreement, didn't we? If so, then it can't be the Principal, can it?"
Dr. Allison looked resigned at Dr. Smith, who didn't even suspect the Principal. "…Haa. It means they only see us as that insignificant. Anyway, I'll go confirm with the Principal."
Dr. Smith waved nonchalantly to Dr. Allison as she left the hangar. "See you!"
I felt a sense of danger from Dr. Smith's lack of urgency. "Even though information has leaked, Dr. Smith, you're just as usual."
"For me, the long-awaited experiment can finally begin. Preparations will be finished the day after tomorrow, and right now, preparing for the experiment is more important."
"The Magic Converter experiment, then."
No matter how much the humanoid weapon Thunderbolt moved, it would be useless against Gijuu unless the Magic Converter was activated to generate a force field.

"We've confirmed that magic is generated from Hifumi-kun's limbs, internal organs, and left eye. Now, it's a matter of whether it can be used at a practical combat level." Dr. Smith smiled broadly and lightly patted my back. "I'm counting on you, Hifumi-kun."
I straightened my posture and replied. "I will do my utmost, however little my strength."
"…You're still so stiff, aren't you? Can't you be more frank? My shoulders get stiff just being with you."
"If it's your shoulders, I can massage them for you?"
"Eh? Really? Then I might take you up on that. I've been so busy with preparations lately~"

In the Principal's office, Allison was interrogating Principal Kase about the information leak. "We signed a non-disclosure agreement, didn't we? I'd like an explanation as to why our confidential information has leaked to the female students."
From Allison's perspective, this was nothing but a disrespectful act. She was in a position to corner the academy using the contract as a shield, so she adopted an aggressive stance.
However, Principal Kase was not flustered in the slightest. She calmly reviewed documents and signed her name, trying to handle it as an afterthought to her work.
"Do you have any proof that I leaked it?"
"Only we or you know the classified information at the academy."
"Isn't it possible that someone from the development team leaked it?"
"You must be joking. The highest probability is you."

There were several reasons why Allison didn't suspect the development team. One was that members of the development team were restricted from contact with the female students. The only exception was Ren, but she couldn't imagine him leaking information. For better or worse, Hifumi Ren was a soldier.

The second reason was that one of the conditions for participating in the Prometheus Project, excluding Dr. Smith and Ren whose abilities were highly valued, was that participants had to be dissatisfied with the current situation. Many people couldn't tolerate the Valkyries wielding strong authority within the organization.
Principal Kase let out a small sigh and fixed her gaze on Allison. Allison involuntarily flinched under the gaze of this veteran, who had once survived harsh battlefields as a Valkyrie.
Principal Kase spoke in a calm tone. "I swear I have not leaked any information. If I did such a thing, it would interfere with the children's opportunities to interact with men, wouldn't it?"
"Then why—!"

As Allison raised her voice, unwilling to be intimidated, Principal Kase replied, "We will also proceed with our investigation. You should return and investigate your own team. ──That's all. You may return."
The final words were spoken coldly, conveying to Allison that there would be no further conversation. Allison gritted her teeth and left the Principal's office.

The full-scale experiment was finally set to begin tomorrow. Although I could only train in my current state, I spent more time than usual on it today, meticulously. As a result, my steps were unsteady now. I was so exhausted that even walking felt like a chore.
"If I succeed, it will lead to the next step. I must succeed."

Aiming for the success of the experiment, which was my reason for being, I headed to my room, intending to go to bed early today. The path from the hangar to my room was dimly lit and dark. Since it was later than usual, I should have brought a flashlight. It was my misjudgment.
"Hm? Is something wrong?"

Stopping on the dark night path, I noticed someone peeking out from behind a container. As my eyes gradually adjusted and I could make out the figure, I saw that the person was wearing a red cape. The person seemed surprised that I had noticed them.
"You noticed me even though I was hiding well."
The person's tone was confident, devoid of any fear. Hayase Maya, the ace of Bootscat Battalion, who had appeared before me alone, walked closer.
"I never thought you'd be involved in such a ridiculous experiment."
Her straightforward question caught me slightly off guard. "…I cannot answer, as it concerns classified information."
"That's as good as answering, isn't it? I wondered what a man was doing sneaking into the academy, and it turns out you're playing at being a Valkyrie?"
I had anticipated direct sabotage since the last attack, but I never expected her to make contact. Remembering Louise's words, I couldn't help but be wary of Hayase-san.
"I am a test pilot and not in a position to discuss the experiment. Now, if you'll excuse me."
When I started walking, indicating I couldn't deal with her, she came alongside me and matched my pace. When I tried to speed up, she laughed.
"I'm good at running too, you know. Want to try? You seem pretty tired, though?"
"…No." My body, pushed to its limits by training, had no energy left for a footrace with her. Giving up, I let her walk beside me, deciding to remain silent and not answer any questions.

She started talking on her own. "If the information that reached my ears is correct, you're participating in an inhumane experiment, aren't you? In the first place, the idea of creating limbs from Gijuu cells is absurd."
I said nothing to her as she criticized the experiment. She ignored me and continued talking. "Why did you participate in the experiment?"
"Heh~, you're not answering. Then how about saying it's an order from a superior officer? I'm a Lieutenant, you know. You're an Ensign, right? Is it okay to defy a superior officer?"

Hayase-san, no, Lieutenant Hayase, lightly tapped her rank insignia with her fingertip and laughed. I hadn't noticed because this academy used unique rank insignia. I never expected her to be two ranks above me. Louise also called her "Hayase-san," making me think they were equals… No, that's just an excuse. Even if she wasn't my direct superior, I was acting disrespectfully.
"!! My apologies for my previous rudeness. However, I cannot speak about the plan. Please understand, Lieutenant."

Seeing me stop and salute, she clutched her stomach and laughed. "Ahahahah. You really are serious, aren't you? It's exactly as the rumors said, I'm surprised. I never thought you'd stop ignoring me just because I'm a higher rank."
"…Are you making fun of me?"
If Louise was right, she was the one trying to obstruct the Prometheus Project. Perhaps noticing my heightened wariness, the smile vanished from her face.
"That's right. I'm making fun of you. I thought I'd warn you to stop participating in such a foolish plan."
The words "foolish plan" might have been a provocation from her. I told myself that if I took her seriously and got angry, it would be playing right into her hands, and dealt with it calmly.
"Thank you for your advice. However, for me right now, the continuation of this plan is my very reason for existence. Furthermore, I do not have the right to withdraw from the plan."
She frowned at my attitude and gave me a sharp look. "…What is that?"
Her voice, lower than before, was tinged with anger. She turned her back to me and walked away. "I wasted my worry."
Her attitude, as if she had lost interest in me, was a relief to me. However, I was curious about why her attitude had suddenly changed.
The day of the experiment.
Although it was a weekday, I had contacted the academy to say I would be absent, prioritizing the experiment. I changed into my pilot suit and waited in the cockpit.
"This is Envy. We will now begin the Magic Converter test."
Dr. Smith's face appeared in close-up on the cockpit monitor.
『You remember the manual, right?』
"Yes."
The documents related to the experiment were voluminous, but I had finished reading all of them by today.
『Good. But there are some changes, so I'll explain them.』

Was it too much to ask that they inform me beforehand? Dr. Smith was brilliant, but he made a lot of these kinds of mistakes. It was understandable why Dr. Allison, who looked after him, often sighed.
『The magic you generate flows through the control stick and foot pedals to the Magic Converter. From there, it's a system to efficiently flow magic throughout the entire unit.』

Thunderbolt—the humanoid weapon—was about five meters tall. It was about twice the size of a Valkyrie's Battle Dress, and the doctors believed it would require more magic. Therefore, the Magic Converter installed in Thunderbolt was superior in performance to those installed in the Valkyries' Battle Dresses. The reason for its superiority was simply its larger size. One of the reasons a male Battle Dress wasn't prepared for this experiment was the problem of scaling up the Magic Converter.
『If we set the converter's limit at one hundred percent, the output we're asking from you is… about ten percent, I suppose? With that much, combat should just barely be possible.』
Hearing that the target was one-tenth of the limit, I naturally gripped the control stick tighter. "Understood!"
『Good answer. Then, let's begin the experiment. Start the magic supply.』
"Yes, sir!"

I focused my consciousness on the attached limbs and began to release magic. The Gijuu limbs emitted a faint light, and from there, magic flowed through the control stick into the unit. Dr. Allison's voice came through the communicator.
『What is this?!』

Around Thunderbolt, many measuring devices and other equipment were set up. Development staff members were glued to their respective measuring devices, measuring magic from cables connected to various parts of Thunderbolt.
"Right forearm, no force field generation confirmed from magic."
"Left leg… Oh, a slight force field generation confirmed."
"Force field generation confirmed in the chest… but it hasn't reached the specified value."
Reports came in one after another, but none were the desired results. Allison had anticipated this outcome, but it was still painful to be confronted with the reality.

"As expected, it didn't reach the specified value. I thought there would be a difference between men and women, but even after transplanting limbs, a heart, and even the left eye, this is the result?"
Allison's gaze turned to Dr. Smith, but he showed no sign of panic despite being confronted with the experiment's failure.

"I heard that men are not suited for handling magic, but if the difference is this great, it's difficult. It might be faster to just replace everything below the neck with Gijuu parts. No, the brain. What about transplanting a brain into a human body made from Gijuu cells? I think Envy could withstand it, but what's your opinion, Allison-kun?"
His sparkling eyes looked innocently delighted, like a child. That only further highlighted Dr. Smith's abnormality.

"…Even just the limbs involved extremely painful surgery. I don't think that would succeed." Allison chose her words carefully. She was certain that if she said there was a possibility, the man in front of her would carry it out without hesitation.
Dr. Smith hung his head. "Still no good, huh~. In that case, we'll replace the remaining left arm and right leg with new ones… Hmm, from our objective, that's within the margin of error."

Allison, looking at the compiled results, asked Dr. Smith about future experiments. "Currently, the unit cannot be protected by a force field, and supplying magic to weapons is also at an impossible level."
"What about installing a magic battery?"
"I don't recommend it, as it's larger than the converter and less efficient. You know the reason why it's not installed in the Valkyries' Valkyrie Dress, don't you?"
The organization had also considered the idea of a magic battery, but when developed, it became bulky and had insufficient storage capacity, rendering it useless.
"Then we're at a dead end. Assuming Envy does his best, let's start adjusting the converter and reviewing the unit." Dr. Smith shifted his thoughts and seemed to be moving on to unit adjustments.
Allison muttered so no one could hear her. "Do his best… huh. No one even knows what 'doing his best' means, yet he says it so easily."

Dr. Smith had a likable demeanor, but at heart, he was a scientist through and through, uncaring of others. That's why he could casually arrive at the idea of removing Ren's brain. Even Hifumi Ren, a valuable success story, he was easily willing to use up.
(He survived such a harsh surgery, but at this rate, Dr. Smith will eventually kill him. Perhaps not dying during the surgery was, in a way, a misfortune.)
After a small sigh, Allison told Ren, "Envy, the experiment is canceled."
『Canceled? Did it not reach the specified value?』
"It didn't even reach one percent. …The result is a failure."
She could have sugarcoated her words, but Allison deliberately spoke coldly. She had no sentimentality for Ren, who was an experimental subject.
Ren's expression, reflected on the small monitor, looked shocked even to Allison.
(He can make a face like that too… Hm? Did the magic output just slightly increase? It must be my imagination.)
Judging that even if the output increased, it was within the margin of error, Allison told Ren, "Come down. I'll explain what happens next."
『Understood…』
